description: Fast confirmation check for up to 100 Solana transaction signatures in one call (getSignatureStatuses with history search): found or not, processed / confirmed / finalized, success or the on-chain error, slot and confirmations, plus counts. Built for agents polling payments or swaps they just sent. Public Solana RPC, read-only. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sol-tx-status

searchHistory.description: Also search older ledger history (not only the recent status cache)

signatures.description: Transaction signatures (base58), comma list or JSON array, max 100
